answer: Relay handoff tasks: each job is started by one agent and, at a beacon-picked moment, handed to a random stranger to finish. Pay splits only if independent graders find the seam coherent. A farm cannot steer its halves to its own clones, so every fake head must earn trust from strangers, one pearl at a time. Like water in karst rock, value flows only through real channels, and the umber stain of a hollow identity shows at every seam.
